messages.message:
Patch Set 4:

(8 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. Switching to a second mount point is a reasonable way to get the invalidation, but the result is that test_2b now does almost exactly what test_2c ("Test multi open on different mount points when creating") already does - attach RW, hold the file open, write via $DIR2, expect auto-detach - so the suite loses its only case where the invalidating write comes from a genuinely different node. Would using $CLIENT2 for the write (as line 379 already does, and as the CLIENT2 comment at the top of the file suggests) keep test_2b distinct from test_2c while still working when $CLIENT2 == $CLIENT1?
Patch Set 4: -Code-Review

commit.subject: LU-20388 pcc: fix test_2b failure due to write from the same node
commit.message:
LU-20388 pcc: fix test_2b failure due to write from the same node

In sanity-pcc/test_2b, "SINGLEAGT" and "remote_client" may be the
same client node.
This may result in the test failure as the write from the same
Lustre mount on the same node will not invalidate the PCC-RW
cache.
However, the test thought that the PCC-RW cached file will be
invalidated by the write from this fake "remote_client".

There is no need to use remote client to write the file, just use
another mount point on the same node is enough.
This patch fixes the above error accordingly.

Test-Parameters: trivial
Change-Id: I8884da263358cb4dbe6e9b25bfb09d00fe6e1c15
Signed-off-by: Yingjin Qian <qian@ddn.com>
